scope_statement: Accessible local harddisk artifacts only. No remote server/job inspection and no reruns. Filename inventory is broad; numeric inspection prioritizes completed aggregate comparison artifacts. Raw image/model tensors and massive predictions were not read.

report_tables.title: Historical v2: actual N=300 reports
report_tables.title_zh: 旧v2实测：同一300请求，原始报告
report_tables.note: Same request hash e02da65e...; reference geometry conditional on valid labels and completed layouts, so GPT prompt has 293 layouts vs 300 for other rows. Clean denominator here is all 300 requests. All old strict rates are 0 because unchecked mesh/physics/solver hard checks count unknown as failure. This is not modern admission. FastFill checkpoint-selection cohorts include these 300 scenes; do not call this held-out FastFill test. Original OOR is a different proxy from modern soft OOR.
report_tables.note_zh: 原始实测同一300请求（SHA e02da65e…）。GPT prompt只完成293间，其余完成300间；几何误差仅对完成且标签有效对象统计，故完成分母不同。clean_rate_all统一除以300。旧strict把mesh/physics/solver未检查的unknown视为失败，因此全为0，不能等同新027严格准入；旧OOR代理也不同于新版soft OOR。这300场景参与FastFill选模，不能称FastFill独立留出测试。

report_tables.title: Historical v2: common
report_tables.title_zh: 旧v2最终配对：共同完成293间
report_tables.note: All four methods evaluated on the same 293 completed rooms; geometry label counts are metric-specific. Final FastFill = yawcls05 step5000; all 300 scenes occur in checkpoint-selection cohorts. Bootstrap 10000 seed0; CI and denominators retained in numeric_records/CSV. Latency FastFill 0.0964185208s uses GPU forward+decode (argmax row reuses spread timing); GPT prompt45.8564348771s, harness33.4993478580s include API wait/retry/backoff, so scopes differ.

report_tables.note_zh: 四方法共同完成的293间配对；各几何指标有效对象数不同，精确分母与95%CI保留在CSV/JSON。FastFill为yawcls05 step5000，这300个源场景全部在选模队列中。bootstrap10000次seed0。FastFill延迟0.0964秒仅单房GPU前向及解码，argmax复用了spread计时；GPT prompt45.8564秒、harness33.4993秒含API限流等待、重试和退避，计时范围不同。

report_tables.note_zh: 统一300请求，GPT prompt缺失的7间用房间中心位置、评估集留一法类别尺寸中位数、均匀角度误差期望、BEV IoU=0补入，clean=0；这些是含失败回退的几何数值，不是原始仅完成均值。FastFill为yawcls05 step5000；源场景参与选模。bootstrap10000次seed0，分母和CI保留。FastFill与GPT延迟计时范围不同，不直接作纯推理速度比。

report_tables.title: Historical v2 minimal test, N=4455
report_tables.title_zh: 旧v2 minimal测试：4455请求，含朴素基线
report_tables.note: Minimal=三字段投影; full=完整条件投影. Same input file SHA212fc6bf..., different eligible subsets. main7 max128 objects vs main4 max256; this comparison changes data recipe/capacity, not a pure one-factor ablation. Clean/layout and clean/all are both retained. Old strict includes unknown hard checks and is not amendment027 strict admission. Naive baseline fits evaluation-set leave-one-out and is paired to final-spread label objects, not trained only on training data. Position means show the naive baselines outperform learned heads here. Exact per-metric N and CI preserved; 2000 bootstrap seed0.
report_tables.note_zh: 三字段minimal投影4455请求，不是完整条件8620请求；同一输入文件SHA212fc6bf…但合格子集不同。main7 max128对象、main4 max256，包含数据配方和容量差异，并非纯单因素消融。表同时保留clean/完成与clean/全部；旧strict包含硬检查unknown，不是027严格准入。朴素基线在评估集留一法拟合，并配对final-spread有效标签对象，不是只用训练集拟合。朴素位置误差优于学习模型，也照实保留。每指标分母和95%CI见CSV，bootstrap2000次seed0。

report_tables.title: Historical v2 full test, N=8620
report_tables.title_zh: 旧v2 full测试：8620请求，含朴素基线
report_tables.note: Minimal=三字段投影; full=完整条件投影. Same input file SHA212fc6bf..., different eligible subsets. main7 max128 objects vs main4 max256; this comparison changes data recipe/capacity, not a pure one-factor ablation. Clean/layout and clean/all are both retained. Old strict includes unknown hard checks and is not amendment027 strict admission. Naive baseline fits evaluation-set leave-one-out and is paired to final-spread label objects, not trained only on training data. Position means show the naive baselines outperform learned heads here. Exact per-metric N and CI preserved; 2000 bootstrap seed0.
report_tables.note_zh: 完整条件full投影8620请求，不与三字段minimal4455合并；两者同源文件但评测条件及子集不同。main7 max128对象、main4 max256，不能只归因于yaw损失权重。clean/完成和clean/全部均保留；旧strict把硬检查unknown纳入失败，不能套用新版027含义。朴素基线是评估集留一法并配对final-spread有效标签对象，不是训练集统计；其位置误差更好也完整列出。每指标分母与95%CI在CSV，bootstrap2000次seed0。

report_tables.title: Single training sample diagnostic
report_tables.title_zh: 单个训练样本的训练前后诊断
report_tables.note: Complete real GPU diagnostic, not self-test; MultiScan::scene_00057_01 training sample only. Before is reconstructed seed42 initialization (no saved pre-training state). After is pilot4steps. Not evidence of held-out generalization.
report_tables.note_zh: 真实GPU单样本诊断，非self-test；只有MultiScan::scene_00057_01训练样本、3对象。before为按seed42重建的初始化，没有保存的训练前状态；after为4步pilot。不能作为留出集泛化或有效布局质量对照。

report_tables.title: RoomGenBench input handoff diagnostics
report_tables.title_zh: RoomGenBench输入场景的交接代理检查
report_tables.note: Five scenes,313 objects per model. Two FastFill variants using RoomGenBench inputs, not a RoomGenBench layout-method baseline. Target-bbox proxy tolerance.001m. File explicitly says asset_retrieval=not_attempted, mesh=not_checked, support=unknown, physics=not_checked. OBB overlap fail counts are pairs, not failed-room rates.
report_tables.note_zh: 5场景、每模型313对象。这是两种FastFill在RoomGenBench输入上的交接代理检查，不是RoomGenBench布局方法基准比较。target_bbox_proxy容差0.001米，OBB失败数是重叠对象对数；资产检索未尝试、网格未检查、支撑unknown、物理未检查，不能解释为真实网格碰撞通过率。
